chapter: The Raeburn band: people and touring
title: Groupies
summary: Girls followed bands from town to town even then.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: Did the bands then have groupies the way the bands have them now?

Sure. You mean all these little chicks hanging out backstage? Yeah, there were girls who used to follow the band from town to town. I don't know if they do it to the extent that it's being done now because as free as the kids were then, they weren't as free as today's kids. The morals were completely different. They were beginning to get into today's morals even back then. There will always be kids attracted by the show business life, the musician's life, that will follow them.
